create_scripted_act_component: create a ScriptedActComponent with a language model and a list of scripted action dictionaries
get_action_attempt_scripted: call get_action_attempt on ScriptedActComponent to return the next scripted action line for the entity
context_for_action_ordered: assemble component contexts in a specified order using the component_order parameter of ScriptedActComponent
get_state_scripted_act: call get_state on ScriptedActComponent to serialize the script and current line index to a dictionary
set_state_scripted_act: call set_state on ScriptedActComponent to restore the script and line index from a saved state dictionary
